title: The product owner's decision on an item the team could not build as written

decision.description: split: the same scope in smaller items the team builds one by one. ask: a decision about what the product does, which is the owner's.

reason.description: One or two sentences on why.

body.description: What to build and its acceptance criteria, as - AC-001: ... lines.

items.description: For split: the smaller items, in the order to build them. Together they cover the whole item.

question.description: For ask: the question, in the owner's words, about what the product does.

options.description: For ask: two to four options.

recommended.description: For ask: the option you recommend, and why in one line.
